The '''LPL 2024 Spring''' split is the first split of the 2024 [[LoL Pro League]] (LPL) season, held in China from January 22 to April 20, 2024. Seventeen teams competed in an offline format across multiple cities, including Shanghai, Suzhou, Xi’an, Shenzhen, Beijing, and Foshan. The Group Stage used a single round-robin format with best-of-three matches. The top ten teams advanced to the Playoffs, which consisted of a King-of-the-Hill phase followed by a Double-Elimination bracket, with all matches played as best-of-five. The split was contested on patch 14.1B–14.6, with Smolder and Azir disabled during the Group Stage. Bilibili Gaming defeated Top Esports 3–1 in the Grand Finals to claim their first LPL title, while the top teams qualified for the 2024 [[Mid-Season Invitational]].

===Playoffs===
{{ShowBracket|id=tl2OVsUfyX}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' 
** Single round robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** Top 10 advanced to [[LPL/2024/Spring/Playoffs|Playoffs]]
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to Round 2 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''7th till 10th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''11th till 17th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
** Tiebreakers
*** If two or more teams have won the same number of matches, the tie will be broken by the order:
***# Games differential
***# Head-to-head results

* '''Group Stage Side Selection Procedure'''
** The first listed team ("home" team) will pick sides for Game 1 & 3, the second listed team ("away" team) will pick sides for Game 2.
** This order will be reversed when the teams play each other in [[LPL/2024/Summer|Summer]], particularly in the '''Rumble Stage'''.

* '''Playoffs''' 
** '''''Phase One: King-of-the-Hill'''''
*** 3rd - 10th seeded teams from Group Stage are divided into two brackets to play a King-of-the-Hill format
**** 3rd, 6th, 7th and 10th seed are in one bracket (the first bracket), the other 4 seeds are in the other
**** The winners advance to Phase Two
**** The winner of the first bracket faces 2nd seed team in the Double-Elimination Stage, the other faces the 1st seed
** '''''Phase Two: Double-Elimination'''''
*** Four teams play in a Double-Elimination format to compete for the championship
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}

* '''Free Side Selection Privilege'''
** The higher seed team can choose which '''''three''''' games of the {{Abbr/Bo5}} series to exercise side selection. The lower seed team will choose sides when the higher seed team did not exercise such a right.
** This is only for the first round of the Playoffs ''Phase One''.

* '''Standard Side Selection Procedure'''
** For the upper bracket Finals and lower bracket matches in Playoffs ''Phase Two'', the Side seleciton Privilege will be determined by coin toss. Besides that, the higher seeded teams (in Grand Finals, the upper bracket winner) will have the side selection for game 1 of the series.
** Subsequently, the loser of the previous game will have side selection privilege.

==Trivia==
* This was the 7th time in LPL history that the split started and ended with the same matchup. In addition, its the 9th time in LPL history that the top 2 teams in Regular Split meet each other in the Grand Finals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://weibo.com/6931173462/OaBAPjvoO|title=经理笔记：2024LPL春季赛决赛BLG vs TES|trans_title=Manager Info: 2024 LPL Spring Finals BLG vs TES|date=2024-04-20|language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
* During Game 1 of the Grand Finals, {{player|Elk|pos=bot|flag=cn}} dealt 76580 damage, the highest in a single game for the Split.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://weibo.com/6931173462/OaC25whmk|title=2024LPL春季赛单场最高伤害纪录刷新：76580|trans_title=2024 LPL Spring Split singular game highest damage record: 76580|date=2024-04-20|language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
